learning_objective: 🎯 To experience the joy and freedom of flying a kite while learning how wind and skill work together to make our colorful dreams soar high!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A brand new kite looks incredibly beautiful and shiny as it rests on the ground. It is just waiting for the perfect gentle breeze to lift it up into the bright blue sky.
With a sudden gust of wind and a quick pull of the string, the kite dives and snaps! It rides the wind like a tiny, colorful ship sailing on an invisible ocean of air.
The kite climbs higher and higher until it looks like a small dot in the clouds. It rests at the top of the sky, enjoying the glorious view while the wind is strong.
If the wind suddenly stops or the string gets caught in the branches of a tall tree, the beautiful kite flaps helplessly. It reminds us to be careful and skillfully guide our path.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Design Your Dream Kite!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw the most amazing kite you can imagine on a piece of paper. Give it a special superpower, like a tail that glows in the dark or a string that never breaks!

quick_recap: ⭐ A new kite looks bright, snappy, and beautiful on the clear sky.
⭐ It uses the power of the wind to dive, dip, and soar high.
⭐ The kite rider must skillfully control the string to keep it flying smoothly.
⭐ We must be careful so our kite does not get caught and torn in a tree.
